appeal.usage: Usage: `{prefix}appeal list [userId]`, `{prefix}appeal view <userId>`, `{prefix}appeal approve|deny|dismiss|blacklist <userId> [note]`, `{prefix}appeal link <userId>`, or `{prefix}appeal config ...`
appeal.nonePending: There are no pending ban appeals.
appeal.notFound: No appeal record was found for that user.
appeal.linkUnavailable: No appeal link is available for that user.
appeal.linkSent: The appeal link was sent to your Fluxer DMs.
appeal.linkDmFailed: I could not DM the appeal link. Check your DMs and try again.
appeal.notPending: That appeal is not pending. Current state: {state}.
appeal.approveFailed: Fluxer rejected the unban. The appeal was not approved.
appeal.configStatus:
Appeals: **{enabled}**
Review channel: **{channelId}**
Cooldown: **{cooldownDays} day(s)**
Temp bans: **{tempBans}**
Default no-appeal: **{defaultNoAppeal}**
Use `{prefix}appeal config enabled|tempbans|defaultnoappeal on|off`, `channel <channelId|none>`, or `cooldown <days>`.
appeal.configInvalidChannel: Provide a valid Fluxer channel ID or `none`.
appeal.configInvalidCooldown: Cooldown must be a whole number from 0 to 365 days.
